steps.en: Form offers a dropdown of revival reasons
Revival cannot continue until a reason is chosen
steps.id: Revival tidak bisa lanjut sebelum alasan dipilih

steps.en: Remarks are optional free text, up to 200 characters
steps.id: Remarks opsional, teks bebas sampai 200 karakter

steps.en: Reason and remarks go with the revival under the officer's ID
steps.id: Alasan dan remarks ikut proses revival atas nama officer
